semantics.identity_rule: Command surface, backend, model, inference request, output, proposal, operation request and execution identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: run-q/run-qc/apply-proposal operations use separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing AI output grants no apply/operation authority.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.

hard_gates.condition: monitor applies model output by viewing

references.purpose: Monitor shows model output→candidate request boundary.
